name: update_customer_profile
description: Update contact details on a customer account. At least one of email, phone or address must be supplied; omitted fields are left as they are. An address whose address_id already exists is replaced in place; without an address_id a new one is added.

address.description: A postal address object. line1, city, state and postal_code are all required; line2, country and address_id are optional.

address_id.description: Existing address to replace. Omit to add a new one.

line2.description: Apartment, suite or unit. May be empty.

error_returns.when: No account exists with the given customer_id.
Nothing to update was supplied, email has no '@', or address is not an object with line1, city, state and postal_code.
